title: Brand fonts never load on the plant network
steps: Open the app on this PC; check the network log (E2E-01, E2E-37).
actual: fonts.googleapis.com dropped by the firewall on every page load; the app falls back to system fonts
cause: index.html links Google Fonts (an external host). The plant network blocks it, so the design fonts are never applied and every load starts a doomed request.
fix: Serve the two fonts from the app itself: put the .woff2 files in public/fonts (available from cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/*, which this network allows), declare them with @font-face in index.css, remove the Google links.

title: Excel upload file inputs have no accessible name
expected: Every form control has a name
actual: Visually hidden <input type=file> without label or aria-label; screen readers announce an unnamed control
cause: The file input is hidden and triggered by the Upload button, but stays in the accessibility tree without a name.
fix: Add aria-label="Upload Excel file" (or tabIndex={-1} aria-hidden="true", since the visible button already opens it).

title: Notification bell covers the page title at 768 px
steps: Open the dashboard at 768 × 1024 (E2E-32 screenshot dashboard-768.png).
actual: The bell button sits on top of the title ("D…ARD", "P…01")
cause: At tablet width the header actions wrap into the title column without reserving its width.
fix: Give the title block flex: 1 1 auto with min-width, or move the actions to their own row below 900 px.

title: Date range: second calendar icon sticks out of its box at 375 px
expected: Both date fields inside the filter panel
actual: The "to" date's calendar icon overflows the field's right edge
cause: The two date inputs keep their intrinsic width in a row that is narrower than both together.
fix: Let the date row wrap below ~420 px, or set min-width: 0; width: 100% on the date inputs.
